title: A locally finitely presented Cohen-Macaulay morphism splits into open and closed pieces of constant relative dimension
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms of Spaces)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file spaces-more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: For a locally finitely presented Cohen-Macaulay morphism of algebraic spaces, the lemma decomposes the source into open and closed subschemes on which the morphism has constant relative dimension. The proof uses the Cohen-Macaulay hypothesis to make the fibre dimension locally constant on suitable pieces, produces the open and closed decomposition by a constructibility argument, and then checks the relative dimension is constant on each piece. Producing the decomposition from the fibre-dimension behaviour is the load-bearing step. Retained author proof at lines 6445-6468.
